summary: Complaints centre on road sinking after Har Ghar Jal pipe digging, town road and drain proposals still awaiting sanction, and a police-inaction allegation; appreciation is limited to the Har Ghar Jal pipeline and a district-wide project launch.

positives.english: Har Ghar Jal pipelines have been laid through the town
positives.hindi: शहर में हर घर जल की पाइपलाइन बिछ गई
positives.basis: Brajanchal (8 Jul 2026): road restoration followed pipeline laying under the Har Ghar Jal scheme in Sikandrarao town; the article does not say taps are running. Sikandrarao town is counted as inside AC 80 under the namesake-town rule (Wikipedia extent wording 'Hathras Tehsil'; field check advised).

positives.english: 143 development works were launched across the Hathras-district seats, including Sikandra Rao
positives.hindi: सिकंदराराऊ सहित तीन सीटों पर 143 विकास कार्यों का लोकार्पण हुआ
positives.basis: DNP (28 Jun 2026) and ITDC (28 Jun 2026): Rs 548 crore, 143 projects across the Hathras, Sikandra Rao and Sadabad constituencies; ITDC says inaugurated and foundation stones laid. No per-seat split or Sikandra Rao amount given. Launch event, not verified works on the ground.

positives.english: *Every Hathras CHC is to get a mother and child care unit
positives.hindi: *हर सीएचसी पर मां और बच्चा देखभाल यूनिट बनाने की योजना है
positives.basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (22 Feb 2026) says a Mother and Child Care Unit is planned at every CHC in Hathras district and that Sikandrarau CHC work will start soon. Planned only, not delivered; no Sikandrarau-specific amount or date.

positives.english: *Rs 59.20 lakh of town roads and drains proposed for Sikandrarao wards
positives.hindi: *नगर में सड़क-नाली के लिए 59.20 लाख का प्रस्ताव है
positives.basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (16 Jun 2026) says CC road and drain proposals of Rs 59.20 lakh for Sikandrarau wards were sent to the government for approval; not sanctioned yet. Planned only, and the same proposal is also negative 2. Weak as a positive.

positives.english: *Hathras district plans renovation of all seven CHCs
positives.hindi: *हाथरस के सातों सीएचसी का कायाकल्प होने वाला है
positives.basis: Inference: same Amar Ujala article (22 Feb 2026) says all seven Hathras CHCs are to be renovated; district-level plan, no amount, no start date, and status as of Oct 2026 not found.

negatives.english: Residents say roads sank and got potholes after the Har Ghar Jal pipe digging
negatives.hindi: हर घर जल की पाइपलाइन के बाद सड़कें धंस गईं, गड्ढे बन गए
negatives.basis: Brajanchal (8 Jul 2026): residents say restored roads were not repaired to standard; after rain several roads sank and potholes formed, including inside the tehsil campus. Residents allege trenches were not backfilled and compacted before asphalt/CC work. No official or contractor response in the article. Sikandrarao town is counted as inside AC 80 under the namesake-town rule (Wikipedia extent wording 'Hathras Tehsil'; field check advised).

negatives.english: Town road and drain works are stuck waiting for sanction
negatives.hindi: नाली और सड़क के काम मंजूरी में अटके हैं
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (16 Jun 2026): Rs 59.20 lakh CC road and drain proposals for Sikandrarau wards (incl. Eidgah Road area and ward 01 in front of the police station) sent to the government for approval; work to begin only after sanction. Status as of this date. Sikandrarao town is counted as inside AC 80 under the namesake-town rule (Wikipedia extent wording 'Hathras Tehsil'; field check advised).

negatives.english: Police allegedly did not act on a complaint at Sikandrarau station
negatives.hindi: सिकंदराराऊ थाने में शिकायत के बाद भी कार्रवाई नहीं हुई, आरोप है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (14 Oct 2026): CJM court in Hathras registered a separate case and summoned the Sikandrarau station in-charge for 17 Oct, after he neither appeared nor filed the inquiry report ordered within 15 days. The complainant alleges police took no action after her complaint; these are her claims as reported. Article has no police response. Station-area membership in AC unconfirmed.

negatives.english: A car hit a tractor on GT Road near Sardhla bridge, killing an elderly man
negatives.hindi: जीटी रोड पर सरधला पुल के पास कार-ट्रैक्टर टक्कर में बुजुर्ग की मौत
negatives.basis: Hamara Hathras (12 Oct 2026), datelined Sikandrarao: on the Etah-Aligarh GT Road near Sardhla bridge a car hit a paddy-laden tractor; an elderly man died after being taken to the CHC and two others were seriously injured. Single incident, not a pattern; location is near the town. Sikandrarao town is counted as inside AC 80 under the namesake-town rule (Wikipedia extent wording 'Hathras Tehsil'; field check advised).

negatives.english: Sikandrarau CHC upgrade work was still awaited
negatives.hindi: सिकंदराराऊ सीएचसी के सुधार काम का इंतजार है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (22 Feb 2026): work at Sikandrarau CHC 'will start soon' (जल्द); no start date, approval status or amount given. Status after Feb 2026 not found, so this reflects Feb 2026 only and may be out of date.

notes: AC 80 Sikandra Rao, Hathras district, reserved None; AC page verified on Wikipedia. Namesake-town rule applied: Sikandra Rao town counts as inside AC 80, as for every other AC, because no source explicitly places the town in a different AC. Wikipedia's extent says 'Hathras Tehsil' only, and the district's tehsil list names Sikandrarao as a separate tehsil; neither states that the town is outside AC 80. ac_specific_negatives is 3: negatives 1, 2 and 4 are datelined or located in Sikandrarao town (Brajanchal 8 Jul 2026 on town roads; Amar Ujala 16 Jun 2026 on town wards; Hamara Hathras 12 Oct 2026, datelined Sikandrarao). Negative 3 (a Hathras CJM court report about the Sikandrarau station) and negative 5 (a district-level CHC item from Feb 2026) are not datelined to the town and are not counted. Field-check the 2008 delimitation extent before publication. P2 weak positive: launch event for 143 works across three seats, with no per-seat split and no verified works on the ground. P3 weak positive: planned only, not delivered. P4 weak positive: proposal only, not sanctioned; duplicates negative 2. P5 weak positive: plan only, with no amount or start date. Positives are thin: only the Har Ghar Jal pipeline and the 143-project launch are sourced as delivered or launched. Positives 3-5 are planned works flagged as inference and do not meet the 'appreciated benefit' rule; positive 4 duplicates negative 2. No completed Sikandrarau road, water, or CHC work was found in searches. A 2022 Lok Sabha document on saline groundwater and distant drinking water in Sikandrarao and Sadabad villages was seen but could not be opened, so it is not cited. Sikandrarao SHO item is a court-reported allegation about a sensitive case; the complainant is not named. Negative 4 is a single crash. Several Sikandrarau headlines (market, festival, flower showers) were not benefits or grievances and were not used.

round2.changes: Re-opened all 7 cited URLs; dates and figures confirmed, none removed. identity_source now the AC Wikipedia page (AC 80, None, Hathras). Summary no longer says 'stalled' CHC. Negative 1 now attributes sinking to residents' claims. Negative 3 basis rewritten: court action, no police response, complainant's claims. Negative 4 basis corrected to Etah-Aligarh GT Road near Sardhla bridge. Negative 5 reworded to Feb 2026 status. Positive 4 Hindi cut to 10 words. Membership flags added to Sikandrarao-town items. Searched for completed Sikandrarau works and AC village lists; none found. The count was revised to 3 in round 3 under the namesake-town rule.
